$comment: M-321 pre-registration, notice-reader and scorer round MB-03b (queue ~/Buildo/.cursor/MCBYLAWS-QUEUE.md), committed alone before the parser or scorer change. Rule: MB03-Q2 and its addendum (recorded fc117484, batch 2026-10-29-ac; ~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-mb03-q2.answered.md): "A requirement sentence yields one check per stated limit; a figure that defines when the rule applies is a condition, and when it is met every limit in the sentence applies." and "A definition figure that decides whether a rule applies (e.g. within 0.3 m of a building) is not a limit; when the build relies on it, the result discloses the definition and its clause." Change: coa-parse.cjs classifies each figure of a requirement sentence as limit, condition, definition, derived or proposal text (requirementLimits), reads the thousands separator (5,400 m2 is 5400) and never scrubs the word project; a sentence whose only figure is the definition states no limit (A0262#10/#11, A0349#8, A0330#2 City figure none); coa-scorecard.mjs makes one check per limit (row.checks), a row is DIFFER if any checked limit differs, else the first OWED/NO ANSWER, else MATCH; a limit with no keyed target is listed and does not decide the row; a named compass lot line is a side lot line; where the notice sets a different limit per named side and the model's one side setback equals one of them, the other sides have NO ANSWER; the definition is carried as a disclosure (code attached_platform_definition). Stored notices are re-derived (values only; *.pre-mb03b kept) and the word project restored in 2 sentences (A0203/26EYK#2). Expected class moves are listed per set; every other row keeps class and City figure. The 5 floor lines below hold.
